security.meaning: Sự bảo đảm, vật bảo đảm.
security.example: They need to provide some security for the large loan.
Investors are watching the stock market and every new security.

see about.example: I'll see about whether we can manage it.

see into.meaning: Đi cùng ai đó vào văn phòng.
see into.example: Her secretary saw me into her office.

see off.meaning: Đuổi ai đó hoặc cái gì đó đi.
see off.example: A cat came into the back garden but the dog soon saw it off.

see off.meaning: Đi đến sân bay, nhà ga, v.v., để nói lời tạm biệt với ai đó.
see off.example: I went to the station to see them off.

see out.meaning: Tiễn khách ra đến cửa trước khi họ rời khỏi nhà bạn.
see out.example: Are you sure you're going? I'll get your coats and see you out.

see through.meaning: Tiếp tục với một điều gì đó cho đến khi kết thúc.
see through.example: They had a lot of difficulties in implementing the project, but the team saw it through successfully.

see through.meaning: Nhận ra ai đó đang nói dối hoặc lừa dối.
see through.example: The police quickly saw through her disguise and arrested her.

see to.meaning: Giải quyết một việc gì đó.
see to.example: He saw to the arrangements and everything ran smoothly and efficiently.

sell off.meaning: Bán một doanh nghiệp hoặc một phần của nó.
sell off.example: They sold off their research subsidiary.

sell off.meaning: Bán rẻ thứ gì đó vì bạn cần tiền hoặc không cần nó nữa.
sell off.example: She sold off her furniture before she emigrated.

sell on.example: We managed to sell him on the expansion plans.

sell on.meaning: Mua một cái gì đó rồi bán lại cho người khác.
sell on.example: We buy them wholesale and sell them on to the public.

sell out.meaning: Không còn hàng nào vì đã được mua hết.
sell out.example: The tickets for the Primal Scream concert at the Brixton Academy sold out in a couple of hours.

sell out.meaning: Đánh mất tính toàn vẹn nghệ thuật để đổi lấy thành công thương mại.
sell out.example: Most bands sell out when they sign to a major record label, and forget all their principles when pursuing chart success.

sell up.meaning: Bán nhà hoặc doanh nghiệp để chuyển đến một nơi nào đó hoặc làm điều gì đó khác biệt.
sell up.example: We want to sell up and move to the country.

send back.example: I sent my food back because it was overcooked.

send for.meaning: Yêu cầu ai đó đến giúp đỡ.
send for.example: I had to send for a plumber because the radiator was leaking.

send in.meaning: Ra lệnh cho mọi người vào một nơi để xử lý sự cố.
send in.example: The police were sent in to quell the riot as the protesters had started burning cars and wrecking shops.

send in.meaning: Viết thư để lấy thông tin.
send in.example: If you want to enter the competition, you have to send in for an entry form.

send off.meaning: Đuổi một cầu thủ thể thao khỏi trận đấu.
send off.example: The football striker was sent off for arguing with the referee's decision.
I must send this letter off today otherwise it won't get there in time.

send off for.meaning: Đặt hàng một cái gì đó qua đường bưu điện.
send off for.example: I sent off for some jeans that I liked in the catalogue.

send out.meaning: Gửi một cái gì đó cho nhiều người.
send out.example: They sent out a mailshot to all their existing customers.

send out for.meaning: Đặt đồ ăn mang về bằng điện thoại.
send out for.example: We couldn't be bothered to cook, so we sent out for a pizza.

send up.meaning: Bắt chước/đóng giả vì mục đích gây cười.
send up.example: The mischievous schoolboy was standing at the front of the class, sending the teacher up, when the teacher opened the door behind him.

set about.meaning: Bắt đầu làm một việc gì đó.
set about.example: We set about the cleaning and got it done before lunchtime.
The gang set about her as she left the bank.

set apart.meaning: Phân biệt, tốt hơn hoặc khác biệt với những người khác.
set apart.example: The quality of their work sets them apart from their rivals.

set aside.meaning: Lật ngược một phán quyết hoặc quyết định của tòa án.
set aside.example: The Appeal Court set aside the guilty verdict because the evidence was unsatisfactory and declared her not guilty.

set back.example: The car repairs set me back eight hundred pounds.
The accident set the project back several months.

set forth.meaning: Nêu ra hoặc phác thảo một ý kiến.
set forth.example: He set forth his ideas in his autobiography.

set forth.meaning: Bắt đầu một cuộc hành trình.
set forth.example: We set forth at daybreak for the summit of the mountain.

set in.meaning: Thay đổi mùa một cách rõ rệt.
set in.example: Winter has set in; it's started snowing.

set off.example: Terrorists set off a car bomb in the city centre last night. Fortunately, no-one was hurt or killed.
The smoke set the fire alarm off.
We set off for work at seven-thirty.
The company set off its overseas debts against it profits at home.
The dark frame sets the pale drawing off well.

set off.meaning: Gây ra, châm ngòi sự kiện.
set off.example: The pay freeze set off a wave of strikes.

set on.example: He was set on when he left the bar.

set out.example: The figures are set out in the council's annual report.

set out.meaning: Bắt đầu một cuộc hành trình.
set out.example: The explorers set out for the South Pole yesterday morning.
The contract sets out all the details of the agreement.

set to.meaning: Làm việc chăm chỉ hoặc nhiệt tình.
set to.example: If we all set to, we should be able to finish this in a few hours.

set up.meaning: Chuẩn bị thiết bị, phần mềm, v.v. để sử dụng.
set up.example: The technician set up the computer network perfectly.
They set up a dot com company, floated it a couple of years later on the Stock Exchange and made an absolute fortune.

set up.meaning: Cung cấp cho ai đó số tiền cần thiết để sống.
set up.example: Winning the lottery set them up for life.

set upon.example: They set upon her when she was in the car park.

settle down.meaning: Bắt đầu cuộc sống ổn định và nề nếp.
settle down.example: After years of partying and drinking, she finally got married and settled down.

settle for.meaning: Chấp nhận bất cứ thứ gì có sẵn.
settle for.example: We were upset not to win and had to settle for the second prize.

settle in.example: It took him a while to settle in when he moved to Japan.

settle on.example: They couldn't agree at first on a name for their daughter, but finally settled on Alice.

settle up.example: Let's settle up for the dinner the other night.

sex up.meaning: Thêm thắt thông tin để làm cho nó hấp dẫn hơn với người đọc hoặc người nghe.
sex up.example: They tried to sex up the news with extra details.

sea legs.meaning: khả năng giữ thăng bằng trên tàu; quen với môi trường mới
sea legs.example: It took me a few days to get my sea legs, but now I’m fine.

security blanket.meaning: vật làm an lòng, chỗ dựa tinh thần
security blanket.example: She always carries her favorite book as a security blanket during stressful times.

see eye to eye.meaning: đồng quan điểm, hoàn toàn đồng ý
see eye to eye.example: We don’t always see eye to eye, but we respect each other’s opinions.
My boss and I see eye to eye on the direction of the project.

see someone's true colors.meaning: nhìn rõ bộ mặt thật của ai
see someone's true colors.example: She seemed so nice at first, but we saw her true colors when the pressure was on.

see the big picture.meaning: nhìn nhận toàn cục, có cái nhìn bao quát
see the big picture.example: To solve this problem, we need to see the big picture.

see the light.meaning: ngộ ra chân lý, bỗng nhiên hiểu ra vấn đề
see the light.example: I was skeptical about her idea until she explained it to me, and then I saw the light.

see the light.meaning: Hiểu ra vấn đề, giác ngộ, nhận ra chân lý.
see the light.example: After years of struggling with his career, he finally saw the light and decided to pursue his passion.

see through someone.meaning: nhìn thấu tâm can ai, biết người đó đang giả tạo
see through someone.example: I can see through his lies; he’s not telling the truth.

sell like hotcakes.example: The new video game is selling like hotcakes.

sell someone short.example: Don’t sell yourself short. You have a lot of talent.

set one's teeth on edge.meaning: làm chướng tai gai mắt, gây khó chịu
set one's teeth on edge.example: The sound of nails on a chalkboard sets my teeth on edge.

sell someone out.meaning: phản bội, bán đứng ai đó
sell someone out.example: I can't believe you sold me out to the boss.

serve one right.example: After cheating on the test, it served him right to be expelled from school.

set foot in.meaning: Đặt chân đến, bước vào một nơi nào đó.
set foot in.example: It was the first time she had ever set foot in a foreign country.

set free.meaning: Phóng thích, thả tự do cho ai/con vật.
set free.example: The rescued wild bird was nursed back to health and set free.
